compliance_statement: All development and evaluation data will be publicly available under applicable licences or synthetically generated. No classified, operational or service-generated data will be used.

datasets.name: MS COCO 2017 Validation Subset
datasets.description: Standard computer vision benchmark containing 5,000 images with multi-category bounding box annotations, used for primary detector baseline evaluation and regression testing.
datasets.provenance_notes: Public standard benchmark. Offline testing uses deterministic synthetic fixture patterns when full 1GB archive is omitted.

datasets.name: Exclusively Dark (ExDark) Image Dataset
datasets.description: Public low-light object detection benchmark consisting of 7,363 low-light images across 12 object categories (e.g. Person, Car, Bicycle) under low-illumination and twilight conditions.
datasets.provenance_notes: Widely cited academic open benchmark for low-light illumination enhancement (Zero-DCE++) and object detection validation.

datasets.name: DarkFace Low-Light Detection Benchmark
datasets.description: Public dataset of 10,000 low-illumination images taken in real-world nighttime scenarios, used for extreme illumination degradation benchmarks.
datasets.provenance_notes: CVPR UG2+ challenge dataset for nighttime computer vision robustness.

datasets.name: TRINETRA Synthetic Border & Attack Evaluation Suite v1
datasets.description: Deterministically generated synthetic surveillance images and attack scenarios covering label flipping, coordinate tampering, BadNets triggers, low-light shift, fog haze, and replay attacks.
datasets.provenance_notes: 100% synthetically generated offline via mathematical patterns, noise injection, and cryptographic tampering generators. Zero live CCTV or operational data.

datasets.name: NIST TrojAI Benchmark Round 1 Reference
datasets.description: NIST TrojAI benchmark artifact reference containing clean and trojaned deep neural network models with polygonal and patch triggers for evaluating backdoor detection algorithms.
datasets.provenance_notes: NIST public research program benchmark. Adapters verify model format and run L1 trigger inversion when model weights are provided.

datasets.name: NIST TrojAI Benchmark Round 2 Reference
datasets.description: NIST TrojAI Round 2 reference dataset with filter-based triggers and multi-class target classification models.

datasets.name: BackdoorBench Comprehensive Benchmark Suite
datasets.description: Comprehensive benchmark for backdoor attacks (BadNets, Blended, WaNet, LowFrequency, Filter) and defenses (Neural Cleanse, STRIP, Fine-Pruning, Spectral Signatures) across CV models.
datasets.provenance_notes: Standard academic benchmark under MIT license. Adapter verifies trigger patterns and provides offline synthetic BadNets simulation.
